comparison_dimensions: Treatment of Non-Equilibrium and Aging Dynamics

table_data.paper_title: Universal liquid-liquid phase separation of proteins and polypeptides in crowded milieus

columns.Primary Methodological Paradigm: Experimental validation with coarse-grained predictive modeling (SASA regression)
columns.Scope of Sequence/Protein Analysis: Diverse library of 23 proteins (folded globular, IDPs) and minimalistic homo-polypeptides
columns.Thermodynamic Predictive Framework: Logarithmic model correlating $C_{sat}$ to solvent-accessible surface area (SASA) contributions and homotypic binding affinity ($K_D$)
columns.Treatment of Non-Equilibrium and Aging D: Observes viscoelastic transition/rigidification upon aging; distinguishes liquid-like behavior from amyloid formation

table_data.paper_title: Open questions on liquid–liquid phase separation

columns.Primary Methodological Paradigm: Theoretical perspective and synthesis of open questions
columns.Scope of Sequence/Protein Analysis: Broad scope: simple coacervates (prebiotic) vs. biomolecular condensates (cellular)
columns.Thermodynamic Predictive Framework: Highlights limitations of current equilibrium models; calls for quantitative partitioning laws and non-ideal thermodynamics
columns.Treatment of Non-Equilibrium and Aging D: Central focus: out-of-equilibrium environments, stability against Ostwald ripening, and Liquid-to-Solid Transitions (LST)
columns.Key Structural Insights on Interfaces: Emphasizes the need to decipher interfacial structure, adsorption layers, and their role in stabilization and client sequestration

table_data.paper_title: Prediction of phase separation propensities of disordered proteins from sequence

columns.Primary Methodological Paradigm: Machine learning (Neural Networks) trained on active-learning-selected coarse-grained MD simulations
columns.Scope of Sequence/Protein Analysis: High-throughput screening of human IDRome (27,663 IDRs); focus on intrinsically disordered regions
columns.Thermodynamic Predictive Framework: Predicts transfer free energy ($\Delta G$) and saturation concentration ($c_{sat}$) using sequence features (hydrophobicity, charge decoration)
columns.Treatment of Non-Equilibrium and Aging D: N/A (Focuses on equilibrium phase behavior under fixed conditions)
columns.Key Structural Insights on Interfaces: Identifies structural heterogeneity at interfaces; chains prefer perpendicular orientation correlated with strong phase separation propensity

table_data.paper_title: Normal Brownian motion of inert nanoproteins at short timescales in the living cytoplasm

columns.Primary Physical Model: Heterogeneous Environment with Distinct Nano- and Micro-viscosities
columns.Dominant Hindrance Mechanism: Excluded volume effects from immobile structures (long-range)
columns.Spatial Scale of Analysis: Short range (<100 nm) vs. Long range (>100 nm)
columns.Key Regulatory/Structural Insight: Cytoplasm acts as water-like at nano-scale; diffusion is normal Brownian below 100 nm crossover
